permit.applies: The employer, before the employee starts work, to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
permit.first: A review against local labour market demand and supply; the employee also needs a Residence Permit.

fees.what: Foreign Employee Employment Permit (MCIL states there is no fee; the separate Residence Permit is Immigration's)

processing.note: MCIL: '5 -10 working days', longer if more information or investigation is needed.

permit.eligibility: Assessed on MCIL's '6 Metric Point System': relevant qualifications and trainings, relevant work experience, industry development (including the number of Samoan citizens employed), medical and character.

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa), Employment services: Foreign Employment Employee Permit
sources.said: Any non-citizen wishing to work in Samoa must hold a valid Foreign Employment Employee Permit (FEEP). Employers must apply for the permit before the employee commences work. Each permit is tied to the specific employer and role. … Permit conditions: Valid for up to 3 years, subject to conditions deemed appropriate by the CEO. … We review the application against local labour market demand and supply analysis. … The employee must also hold a valid Residence Permit

sources.title: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (Samoa), FEEP Brochure 2025 (image-only PDF; quoted from a transcription saved beside it, page images in WS-feep-brochure-2025-png/)
sources.said: 5 -10 working days (However, depending on the need for additional info/further investigation, etc, the process may take longer) … There is 'NO' fee for FEEP … Up to 3 years, depending on Assessment … Eligibility of application assessed by EP Officer (MCIL) based on 6 Metric Point System.
